notes: Implementation modules (EngineModule) are owned BY their engine; they are NOT ownership roots. The legacy cross-layer-map listed them as separate engines.
Capability is the top ownership root. Workspace/ViewModel/Mapper live in the frontend; Router/Service/Engine/Repository live in the backend.
transaction_intelligence, financial_events, balance_engine, ledger_audit_engine, reconciliation_engine have NO capability owner: they are internal/sub engines consumed by other engines or services.
